chunks: And al-Ridha, peace be upon him, said:
Do not give to your brothers from yourself that whose harm to you is greater than its benefit to them.

key_terms.لِإِخْوَانِكَ: for your brothers; meaning fellow believers or close companions in faith

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام teach about helping others when it causes personal harm?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches balance in helping others, forbidding a person from giving in a way that harms himself more than it benefits his fellow believers. It emphasizes wise generosity and proper regard for one's own rights alongside the rights of others.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3633 - Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) said:
"Do not give to your brothers from yourself what causes you more harm than it benefits them."
